[ACCIONA proprietary (ACRRO + Insight)]

Maestro AI platform at the Umm Al Houl seawater reverse-osmosis desalination plant in Qatar, using AI to lower energy and reagent consumption and reduce the plant's carbon footprint; financed via ACCIONA's decarbonization fund. [ACCIONA Maestro]
